'''Xephi Sep''' was a renowned [[Artist/Legends|artist]]. Both the [[Emperor suite|Emperor]] and [[Kuari suite]]s of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] featured an original [[kinesculpture]] by Sep during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Riders of the Maelstrom">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Xephi Sep was mentioned in [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' book [[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']], written by [[Ray Winninger]]<ref name="Riders of the Maelstrom" /> and published in [[July]] [[1989]].<ref name="Riders of the Maelstrom Amazon">{{Amazon|url=Riders-Maelstrom-Star-Wars-RPG/dp/0874311241|text=Riders of the Maelstrom (Star Wars RPG)}}</ref> A nod to Sep appears in the [[canon]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="Propaganda">''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]''</ref> and released on [[October 25]], [[2016]],<ref name="Propaganda Amazon">{{Harper|url=products/star-wars-propaganda-pablo-hidalgo?variant=32210373345314|text=Star Wars Propaganda}}</ref> in the form of the [[Xephi Sep Award]].<ref name="Propaganda" />
